issues.claim: 熊蜂头部同样由复眼、单眼、触角和口器构成。
issues.problem: 非问题(备案)。三条维基来源均未描述头部解剖,仅 Bumblebee 页提及 proboscis;该断言属教科书级解剖常识,由书籍来源 src-snodgrass-anatomy 覆盖,按规则 pass。
issues.evidence: Bumblebee: "The bumblebee tongue (the proboscis) is a long, hairy structure";Bombus terrestris 页与 Nectar robbing 页未提及头部构成。

issues.claim: 同一巢的工蜂胸部尺寸可差两三倍,体重可差近十倍(不同资料 8–11 倍)。
issues.problem: 非问题(备案)。Bombus terrestris 页给出胸长 2.3–6.9 mm(≈3 倍)、体重 68–754 mg(≈11 倍),与"两三倍""近十倍(8–11 倍)"一致;"不同资料"限定恰当。Bumblebee 页仅支持"体型差异很大",未给倍数。
issues.evidence: Bombus terrestris: "workers exhibit a wide variation in worker size, with thorax sizes ranging from 2.3 to 6.9 mm in length and masses ranging from 68 to 754 mg";Bumblebee: "Sizes are very variable even within species"。
issues.fix: 无需修改。可选:将"胸部尺寸"改为"胸部长度"以贴合来源用词(thorax ... in length)。

issues.claim: 据报道,自 1940 年代起的约五十年间,日本半数以上的苹果园曾用它授粉。
issues.problem: 非问题(备案)。Osmia cornifrons 页支持"1940 年代引入日本"与"超过半数苹果园使用";"约五十年间"的跨度页面表述为渐进增长过程,已用"据报道""约"限定,按已恰当限定处理。idtools 页未给该数据。
issues.evidence: Osmia cornifrons: "first introduced in Japan in the 1940s";"use of O. cornifrons gradually increased until more than half of the apple orchards in Japan utilized this species"。

issues.claim: 1977 年它被引入美国东部,此后在美国东部与中西部定殖。
issues.problem: 非问题(备案)。年份 1977 由维基页支持;idtools 页写 "1970s",为更粗粒度表述,不构成否定。"中西部定殖"由 idtools 页支持,维基页未提及。两来源互补,断言整体被支持。
issues.evidence: Osmia cornifrons: "In 1977, O. cornifrons was introduced in the northeastern United States";Exotic Bee ID: "was intentionally introduced to the eastern U.S. from Japan in the 1970s";"In the U.S., O. cornifrons can be found on the East Coast and the Midwest"。

issues.problem: 非问题(备案)。维基页写 "indigenous to Northern Asia",idtools 页与 Mason bee 页写 eastern Asia(日本、朝鲜半岛、俄罗斯东南沿海),"东亚"与后两者一致,不冲突。
issues.evidence: Exotic Bee ID: "native to eastern Asia and has been found in Japan and Korea as well as the southeast coast of Russia";Osmia cornifrons: "a species of solitary bee indigenous to Northern Asia"。

issues.claim: 中华蜜蜂(Apis cerana cerana)是它在中国最主要的亚种
issues.problem: 非问题(备案)。Apis cerana 页列出 8 个亚种,其中 A. c. cerana 标注为 Chinese honey bee,但页面未比较各亚种在中国的地位;"最主要"属规则允许的限定语,按已恰当限定处理,来源无否定。
issues.evidence: Apis cerana: "subdivided into eight subspecies";"Apis cerana cerana Fabricius (= sinensis) (Chinese honey bee)"。
issues.fix: 无需修改。若追求严格可核,可改为"中华蜜蜂(Apis cerana cerana)是它分布于中国的亚种之一"。

issues.claim: 巢由多片平行悬挂的蜡质巢脾(蜂巢片)组成
issues.problem: 非问题(备案)。"多片巢脾""腔内筑巢""蜡质"均被支持;"平行悬挂"未被逐字提及,但属腔内多巢脾蜜蜂的通识性描述,不影响裁决。
issues.evidence: Apis cerana: "colonies are known for building nests consisting of multiple combs in cavities";"The nest itself is a simple vertical comb made from wax";Honey bee: "the more recently evolved species nest in cavities and have multiple combs"。
issues.fix: 无需修改。可选:简化为"巢由多片垂直的蜡质巢脾组成"以贴合来源用词。

issues.claim: 与亚洲本土植物和传统养蜂关系密切
issues.problem: 非问题(备案)。"传统养蜂"由 Honey bee 页 "traditional honey bee of southern and eastern Asia" 及亚种 A. c. indica 被驯养支持;"与亚洲本土植物关系密切"为泛化表述,三来源均未直接提及,但亦无否定,且不含可核数字。
issues.evidence: Honey bee: "Apis cerana, the eastern honey bee proper, is the traditional honey bee of southern and eastern Asia";"One of its subspecies, the Indian honey bee (A. c. indica), was domesticated"。
issues.fix: 建议收紧为"是亚洲南部与东部的传统饲养蜂种",或补充一条说明其为亚洲本土植物传粉者的来源。

issues.claim: 工蜂体长约 10–11 mm(不同资料约 9–12 mm)
issues.problem: 非问题(备案)。10–11 mm 由 Apis cerana 页直接支持;"不同资料约 9–12 mm"已限定。Worker bee 页的 "12–15 mm" 系泛指工蜂(未提 cerana),不构成否定。
issues.evidence: Apis cerana: "both are medium-sized bees (10-11mm) that generally build multiple comb nests";Worker bee 页未出现 cerana。
